relationships.subject: GSK101
relationships.evidence_quote: Incubation of cultured mouse TG neurons with TRPV4 selective agonist GSK101 at 10 nM for 15 min significantly elevated the secretion of CGRP, which was abolished by conditional KO of Trpv4 or pretreatment with TRPV4 selective inhibitor GSK205 at 10 μM

relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: Behavioral tests demonstrated that cKO of Trpv4 in TG neurons significantly suppressed the reduction of bite force in both models

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: I.a. or i.m. micro-injection of CGRP at doses of 10μg/10μL and 30 μg/10μL into the TMJ or masseter muscle significantly lowered the bite force

relationships.subject: olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic blockade of CGRP receptor by i.p. injection of olcegepant (3mg/kg and 10 mg/kg), a CGRP receptor inhibitor via binding to RAMP1/CLR25, 68, significantly blunted the reduction of bite force

relationships.subject: TRPV4
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, elevation of CGRP levels was completely suppressed in sensory neuron-Trpv4 cKO mice.

key_findings: Sensory neuron-specific Trpv4 cKO reduces TMD pain (bite force) in TMJ inflammation and masseter injury models
TRPV4 activation in TG neurons triggers CGRP secretion; CGRP elevation in tissues depends on neuronal TRPV4, and CGRP receptor blockade attenuates TMD pain
